title: L8 partition adoption v1
description: Candidate adoption-view transport for a stored v1 cluster partition. The stored partition stays adopted=false (cluster.ts:38-42, cluster.ts:817); this document is the adopted VIEW, never a rewrite of stored bytes (putPartition refuses a digest change under the same id, graph-store.ts:325-326, and the planAdoption clone is not durable, lineage.ts:719). explicit=true is a documented decision intent, never proof of acceptance or effective adoption. The schema proves nothing about digests, HOST authority, quiescence or cross-document relations: all such checks are relational and reserved to future code and durable receipts (DESIGN.md). Strict harness subset: no pattern, no $ref, no combinators.

partitionId.description: Adopted partition id; not a lineage id. Identity fields mirror cluster-partition-v1 (schemas/cluster-partition-v1.schema.json:33-91).

lineageId.description: Partition lineage id; must differ from partitionId (relational).

snapshotFingerprint.description: Graph snapshot normalized fingerprint 64 lowercase hex characters; schema cannot use pattern.

configFingerprint.description: Algorithm configuration fingerprint 64 lowercase hex characters; schema cannot use pattern.

proposalFingerprint.description: Proposal fingerprint of the adopted partition with adopted forced false: hash(canonical({...partition, adopted:false})) (lineage.ts:900); equals the l4-lineage-2 sidecar projectionFingerprint (lineage.ts:414,967). Computed over content only; it confers no authority (lineage.ts:491). Equality checks are relational; schema cannot use pattern.

observedDigest.description: Digest observed in the stored partition column (graph-store.ts:322). The schema does not claim it equals the partition fingerprint: that equality and immutability (same id, changed digest refused, graph-store.ts:325-326) are relational code invariants.

fromRevision.description: Knowledge revision before the adoption delta; bounds mirror knowledge-delta-v1 (schemas/knowledge-delta-v1.schema.json:35-40).

toRevision.description: Knowledge revision after the adoption delta (knowledge-delta-v1:41-46). Per-unit revision lives in each quiescence proof (lineage.ts:646).

items.description: Exact mirror of UnitQuiescenceProof (lineage.ts:640-651). One proof per unit and same-id-set match with the inventory are relational (lineage.ts:694,701-705); verification is the real L6 authority callback (lineage.ts:661-662), never a JSON shape.

unitId.description: Work unit id; no bound asserted here beyond the relational join to the inventory.

snapshotId.description: Unit snapshot id; equality with the inventory unit snapshot is relational (lineage.ts:704).

items.description: Attempt id; no bound asserted here.

attemptIds.description: Attempt ids of the unit; no item-count bound asserted here.

items.description: Claim id; no bound asserted here.

claimIds.description: Claim ids of the unit; no item-count bound asserted here.

authorityRef.description: Non-empty L6 authority reference (lineage.ts:645,706); the reference is not itself proof of authority.

revision.description: Unit knowledge revision at the proof (lineage.ts:646,706).

quiescent.description: Quiescence flag; schema form never proves quiescence.

released.description: Release flag; schema form never proves release.

workerStillExecutable.description: Worker executability flag; false is required relationally (lineage.ts:707).

leaseHeld.description: Lease flag; false is required relationally (lineage.ts:707).

quiescenceProofs.description: Per-unit quiescence proofs; no item-count bound asserted here.

actor.description: Adoption actor bound to a HOST receipt. The closed shape (no kind property) excludes a raw l4-local-proposal-receipt object by form (lineage.ts:456); a local receipt is refused as authority (dispositions C2; lineage.ts:507,680). This proves nothing about the receipt string itself: a falsified hostReceiptRef passes the form, only a future HOST resolver can authenticate (dispositions D5).

hostReceiptRef.description: Non-empty reference of the HOST receipt (lineage.ts:479-481); reference only, never a deserialized authority object.

items.description: Mirror of FrozenActiveUnit (lineage.ts:88-101) without executionContext (unknown, non-JSON; dispositions D6). Absence of attempt/claim inventories stays UNKNOWN, never replaced by an empty authoritative list.

unitId.description: Work unit id; no bound asserted here beyond the relational join to work-unit documents.

snapshotId.description: Unit snapshot id; units stay snapshot-bound (lineage.ts:711).

ownedFunctionIds.description: Possessed functions; uniqueness and count are relational (lineage.ts:702,711); no item-count bound asserted here.

items.description: Attempt id; no bound asserted here.

attemptIds.description: Optional attempt inventory; absence is unknown, never an empty authoritative list (lineage.ts:93-95).

items.description: Claim id; no bound asserted here.

claimIds.description: Optional claim inventory; absence is unknown (lineage.ts:93-95).

attemptId.description: Attempt id; no bound asserted here.

attempts.description: Optional attempt details; same-id-set with attemptIds is relational (lineage.ts:699,702).

claimId.description: Claim id; no bound asserted here.

claims.description: Optional claim details; same-id-set with claimIds is relational (lineage.ts:700,703).

inventory.description: Active unit inventory; single inventory entry per unit id is relational (lineage.ts:687-688,697); no item-count bound asserted here.

explicit.description: Documented explicit decision intent (planAdoption input, lineage.ts:656,689,717); never proof of acceptance, scheduler activation or adoption effectiveness.
